## Review checklist

- [ ] The PR title is a valid conventional commit subject.
- [ ] The change stays within the linked issue or explicitly explains any scope change.
- [ ] New behavior has tests, or the PR explains why a test does not apply.
- [ ] Documentation and support/coverage claims match tested behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, private keys, sensitive packet captures, browsing history, or unnecessary household data are included.
- [ ] New third-party artifacts/dependencies have known provenance and applicable license terms.
- [ ] Network-changing behavior, if any, is deliberate, verified, auditable, and has a recovery path.
- [ ] The final diff has been reviewed and substantive review threads are resolved before merge.
- [ ] Required CI is green for the exact current head commit.
